description: Bootstrap script that initializes write_service heartbeat and creates core DuckDB tables (mcp_server_registry, mcp_signal_scores, mcp_signal_enrichments, mcp_threat_associations, mcp_risk_register, mcp_attestations, mcp_definition_history, mcp_submissions, mcp_exemptions, mcp_decisions, mcp_policy_rules, mcp_fingerprints, mcp_tool_hashes, service_health, audit_log). Executes via write_service admin path POST :8772/execute. All daemons depend on these tables existing. Priority: all heartbeats currently show never-seen because tables are missing.
